title: Mean time to detect — critical findings
summary: Time between the earliest available evidence of a critical finding in telemetry and the moment a SecOps-NG detection fires on it. Lower is better.

target.rationale: ENISA good-practice baseline for critical-severity findings.

measurement.formula: p95( detection.first_fire_time - telemetry.first_event_time ) over findings of severity in {critical} within window.

inputs.name: first_event
inputs.description: earliest OCSF event time for the affected host

inputs.name: first_fire
inputs.description: earliest detection firing time correlated to the finding
